stem: Based on the information shown in this food web, which effect would MOST LIKELY occur if the insect population decreased?

options.label: A
options.text: The number of bald eagles would increase.

options.label: B
options.text: The number of small fish would decrease.

options.label: C
options.text: The number of sea ducks would decrease.

options.label: D
options.text: The number of phytoplankton would remain the same.

visual_elements: Food web diagram with arrows showing: Phytoplankton → Small fish, Phytoplankton → Insects, Insects → Small fish, Insects → Sea ducks, Small fish → Cranes, Small fish → Ospreys, Small fish → Large fish, Large fish → Bald eagles, Sea ducks → Bald eagles
